defects: CONFIG/PROTOCOL: defaults.yaml makes the effective num_samples 20, versus Ali et al.'s 10000 documents. The first 20 eligible WikiText-103 passages span 1 article, while an evenly spread 20 span 19 articles; against all 1747 eligible passages, prefix-20 fertility moved +2.912% to +5.678%, raw entropy -23.552% to -20.043%, normalised entropy +7.239% to +24.948%, and utilization -96.686% to -94.588% across 6 cached tokenizers.

CODE/NORMALIZATION: _meta_normalised_token_entropy fails both direct invariance mechanisms and NORMALIZERS is empty. Repeating the identical 50/50 distribution from 2 to 200 observations leaves H = 0.693147180560 but moves the reported ratio from 1.000000000000 to 0.130824020648; holding an exact 100-token sequence fixed while expanding the unused vocabulary from V=2 to V=10 moves it from 1.000000000000 to 0.301029995664.

COMPARABILITY, CURRENTLY MITIGATED: fertility, _meta_compression_ratio, and _meta_total_tokens are exact rescalings (Pearson r = 1.000000000000), vocab_size is an architecture parameter, and _meta_vocab_utilization is nearly 1/V (r = +0.997438). The demotions and feature filter now work: is_excluded_predictor returned True for all 10/10 task outputs.

CODE/ITERATION: the task materializes a non-list iterable before slicing. A counting iterator containing 10000 rows was advanced all 10000 times even with num_samples=20, while only 20 rows contributed; an unbounded iterator would never reach evaluation.

CODE/BOUNDARY: fertility divides by max(1, total_words). A three-space input whose test tokenizer emitted 3 tokens had total_words=0 but returned fertility=3.000000 rather than NA/error; this lies outside the papers' nonempty-word domain and therefore does not downgrade fidelity there.

CODE/VALIDATION: the source comment says to assert bounded shares, but the implementation clamps instead. A deliberately inconsistent tokenizer declaring V=2 while emitting 5 distinct ids has raw utilization 2.500000 and raw entropy ratio 2.321928, yet BLME silently reports 1.000000 for both; 0/18 real cached tokenizers triggered this invalid-domain path.

DOCUMENTATION: compression_ratio uses Python len(text), hence Unicode code points, while the module and study paper say UTF-8 character. For one token over the string consisting of e-acute and an emoji, BLME reports 1/2 = 0.500000 tokens per code point, whereas UTF-8 byte length is 6 and gives 1/6 = 0.166667, a 3.0x ambiguity.

DOCUMENTATION/ANALYSIS: docs/TOP_PREDICTORS.md still lists 4 tokenizer columns as active predictors even though current is_excluded_predictor rejects 10/10 outputs and compression_ratio plus total_tokens are exact duplicates of fertility at Pearson r = 1.000000000000.

PROTOCOL: Rust et al.'s released kernel uses UD/CoNLL word tokens, whereas BLME follows Ali et al.'s whitespace denominator. For 'The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.', BERT gives 10/9 = 1.111111 with whitespace words but 10/10 = 1.000000 when punctuation is a separate UD-style token; the boundary convention must accompany any reported fertility.
